We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Likely need to get 1H NMR to see number of methyl signals. Could also get carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbons. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but we have no SMILES. The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra(_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it likely returns the 1H NMR for the sample at hand (the unknown). So we can call it. Then analyze peaks: methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.2 ppm, integration corresponds to 3H each. But we only have textual spectrum maybe with integration. We need to count distinct methyl groups (unique chemical environments). Could also use carbon NMR to count methyl carbons (around 10-30 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
